user: What is the filing deadline for TX-0401?
answer:
The filing deadline for TX-0401 (EUR 240.00, TechMart Online, 2026-07-20) is **2026-09-18**. Today is 2026-09-15, so there are 3 days left. The eligibility check passed for the reason code, transaction status, 60-day window and account status.

This corrects my earlier summary, which said the window had closed. It has not.

Before I file anything, I need you to confirm which charge is the duplicate:

- **TX-0401** (2026-07-20): eligible, and the deadline is 2026-09-18.
- **TX-0402** (2026-07-14): same merchant and amount. Its 60-day window would have closed around 2026-09-12, so it is likely no longer disputable. I have not run an eligibility check on it. I can run one if you want confirmation.

If TX-0401 is the duplicate, tell me and I will open the dispute.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Glossary
## Chargeback window
The number of days, counted from the transaction date, during which a dispute
may be raised under a given reason code.

Limit operations
## Window definition
Limits are tracked on calendar days, not business days. The daily window runs
from 00:00 to 23:59 CET.

Customer security policy
## Card blocking
A customer may block a card immediately. Blocking is reversible for 30 days;
after that a replacement card must be ordered.
